source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original observer patch names stored selection #cachedValue while value remains the getter/setter interface to the internal select. The setter updates both fields and the change handler records user selection. This adopted local name distinguishes two roles; it is not a global cache naming rule or a claim that every restoration edge case is correct.
title: Account Hub cachedValue separates stored selection from the live value accessor
